menuSurfaces.title: Fish Taco North Bethesda Toast Menu

attempts.outcome: Official allergen page links a detailed current guide and publishes cross-contact statements.
Current February 16, 2026 restaurant-issued allergen guide found and inspected.
North Bethesda Toast menu inspected and matched to 10305 Old Georgetown Road.
Targeted search confirmed the current official guide; no conflicting restaurant-issued matrix found.

notes: Formal restaurant-issued allergen positives are preserved.
The guide warns that preparation contact may occur and that vendor substitutions can affect accuracy.
Facility and flour-tortilla cross-contact cautions are retained at restaurant level rather than converted into unsupported item absence claims.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Ingredients may contact other foods during preparation, and complete absence of sesame, peanuts, and tree nuts cannot be guaranteed.
Flour tortillas are manufactured in a facility that also processes peanuts, tree nuts, and sesame.

summary: Fish Taco North Bethesda is confirmed at 10305 Old Georgetown Road. The current February 16, 2026 official allergen guide was found and applied. All 142 frozen rows reconcile into 84 products after removing ingredient/topping/category artifacts and consolidating equivalent matrix and side presentations.
proposedChanges: Remove ingredients, sauces, toppings, descriptions, and category headings promoted as products.
Consolidate equivalent matrix, side, and naming presentations.
Preserve the formal allergen guide and its cross-contact statements with restaurant-issued authority.

findings.finding: A current formal restaurant-issued allergen guide is available.
Frozen extraction promotes many matrix ingredients and toppings to products.

ingredientIntelligence.notes: Run after canonical repair; formal direct evidence remains authoritative.

coordinatorNotes: The packet Toast URL resolves identity to North Bethesda, not Downtown Bethesda.
Cross-contact cautions were retained without unsupported negative claims.
